summary.name: Engraved Mechanical Diagrams
summary.visualIdentity: Porcelain #F0EEE6 field with graphite #222522 engraved linework: number wheels with radial ticks and tabular digits, inspection rails with notches, toothed belts on pulleys, and parallel-line bevel shading. Green #416B53 marks the pointer; orange #E78636 marks the active digit.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: explaining real mechanical or counting operations, such as a carry where one units revolution advances the tens wheel one step. Inferred: technical explainers for video or interactive HTML. Subject, audience, and duration are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Every linked movement must explain a real operation; decorative motion conflicts with the style. Fine engraving patterns need moiré checks at output size. Frame review sampled single frames at 1–8 seconds only; no continuous motion, sub-second timing, audio, or later scenes were verified. The reference poster does not verify full-video scenes.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene-dependent. Porcelain and graphite are source-specified field and ink, but the palette status is only a style-compatible suggestion, not an approved project palette; task-supplied exact colors override it. Green and orange are accents, not backgrounds. Gradients are disabled. Graphite on porcelain measures 13.334:1 for opaque normal text only; verify composited frames, including any textured or transparent backgrounds.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: one GSAP driver `drive`, in input-crank degrees, on a paused timeline derives every linked part. Wheel rotation is -drive×(rA/rB); belt dashoffset is drive×rA×π/180; the rail follows belt travel; digits settle with detent easing. Contours draw in via DrawSVGPlugin. Arrowheads appear only after their shaft completes; wheel labels reveal after their wheel group. Interactivity is unspecified. The 3-second preview turns the units wheel 9→0, carries the tens wheel one detent, and advances the rail.
summary.audio: Unspecified; the style does not mandate audio. Inferred options: restrained background music, narration, mechanical sound effects, ambience, or silence for reading holds. Choose from the brief, honor explicit audio, and do not invent assets. If speech is used, check intelligibility and picture sync.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads, motion-reference candidates, or library IDs are supplied; motion references are optional and empty. Real text in a tabular numeral face is required, but no font is named. Fonts and vector assets must be local and loaded before rendering. Engraved patterns should be authored as vectors and clipped to bevel regions.
summary.combinations: Keep this style dominant. Optional secondary style-097 (verified explanatory quantities) applies only when the brief needs verified quantities; it must not import its palette, replace the porcelain field, or add competing full-scene treatments. In HTML, make motion optional for reduced-motion preferences. Three.js, Manim, and MorphSVG were considered and rejected.
summary.productionApproach: Pipeline: HyperFrames by default (data-composition-id, data-width/height, data-duration, clip timing, window.__timelines registration, check, snapshot, delivery render); Remotion only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Visuals: SVG and HTML/CSS with tabular-nums readouts. Motion: GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin. chroma-js is optional for contrast checks. Rough.js, Delaunator, p5.js, Cytoscape.js, and Leaflet are named in the template but are not entries in this record's stack.
